name: workbench
description: Opens each project into a fixed workbench layout: Explorer, an editor over a terminal, and a Claude terminal beside them. Part of the dotfiles repo.

dotfilesWorkbench.autoLayout.description: Build the dev layout automatically when a folder opens (and no layout was restored).

dotfilesWorkbench.claudeAutostart.description: Run the claude command in the right-hand terminal when its tmux window is first created. Off by default: the column opens a ready shell where you type `claude` yourself.

dotfilesWorkbench.claudeCommand.description: Command run in the right-hand terminal when claudeAutostart is on. Add flags to pin a model, e.g. `claude --model claude-opus-4-8`.

dotfilesWorkbench.claudeDir.description: Directory the right-hand terminal starts in, relative to the workspace root (absolute paths also work). Empty uses the workspace root. Useful when you open a parent folder of several repos but always want claude in one of them.

dotfilesWorkbench.shellPath.description: Path to the terminal launcher. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/dev-shell.
